newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Shell Nigeria says 2 killed in pipeline blast.
newsitem.headline: Shell Nigeria says 2 killed in pipeline blast.

text.p: Embattled Nigerian unit of Royal Dutch Shell Group said two persons were killed Friday when one of pipelines blew up during repair work to contain an oil spillage.
A company spokesman said production had been not been affected.

In a statement, Shell said the accident happened when a contractor crew was repairing the pipeline to Rumuekpe oil field northwest of Port Harcourt in the southeastern oil-producing region of Nigeria.
"Latest reports unfortunately indicate that two fatalities occured as a result of the accident," the statement said.
It did not say what caused the oil spillage which it said was reported on Monday.
Shell is frequently the target of sabotage by impoverished oil-producing communites which feel cheated that Nigerian governments have not used oil wealth to develop their areas.
In its midwestern operational areas, Shell on Friday reported that unknown persons had vandalised a flow station it abandoned since May during ethnic clashes in the area.
